reviewCriteria: One clear focal point and a substantial quiet wall, floor or usable surface.
No competing decorative clusters, prop-filled shelves, layered rugs or repeated miniature objects. Keep functional tools organized.

Level ceilings, vertical walls and straight rectangular openings by default. Record every sloped ceiling, rooflight well or angled wall as a sloped exception; at most three across concepts AND original references.
Plausible supports, glazing, reflections, material junctions, furniture scale and circulation.
Natural exposure, believable fabric and material texture, no plastic sheen or artificial HDR glow.
Retain style identity through material, color and furniture rather than accumulating decoration.
Compare similar-image flags side by side. Reject repeated compositions with merely substituted colors or props.
